title: Incoterms Explained
content:
Incoterms Explained

 Incoterms (International Commercial Terms) define the responsibilities of buyers and sellers in international trade. They clarify who handles shipping, insurance, import duties, and risks at each stage of the delivery process.

title: 8 Biggest Mistakes to Avoid When Sourcing from China
content:
8 Biggest Mistakes to Avoid When Sourcing from China

Sourcing products from overseas especially from manufacturing powerhouses like China can be incredibly rewarding. But without the right knowledge and preparation, it’s also easy to fall into common traps that delay timelines, inflate costs, or lead to substandard products. This guide will walk you through the most common pitfalls businesses face when sourcing and how to avoid them.

title: Intro to China Manufacturing
content:
Intro to China Manufacturing (eBook or Guide)

China is the world’s largest manufacturing hub, offering competitive prices, high production capabilities, and access to a vast array of products. For many businesses, sourcing from China is a key step in building a profitable product-based business. However, navigating this process can be overwhelming for beginners.

This guide provides a practical overview of how to source products from China, covering everything from finding suppliers to understanding minimum order quantities (MOQs), freight, inspections, and protecting your intellectual property (IP).

Download here: Intro to China Manufacturing
